lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife! You're listening to Radio Tenerify, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there — clear blue skies, 26 degrees in the south. Classic Tenerife, really.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Honestly, perfect. If you've been on the fence about heading to the beach today, consider this your sign. Go.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Now, we do want to briefly mention — there was a serious collision back in June involving a tourist bus in Lanzarote that claimed two lives. Our thoughts remain with the families affected.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. On a brighter note though — if you're anywhere near Santa Cruz this weekend, you are in for a treat. The Urban Beach Festival is happening Saturday the 25th down at the Puerto, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: And then Sunday the 26th, Kapo plays his very first Tenerife gig at the Parking del Palmetum. First time on the island — that's a big deal!

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: A massive weekend for live music. Check the webtenerife website for tickets and details.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's all from us — enjoy this beautiful Wednesday, Tenerife. We'll catch you soon on Radio Tenerify!
